name: Change Healthcare (Optum)
short_description: Change Healthcare (now part of Optum) provides enterprise revenue cycle management, clearinghouse services, and healthcare analytics.
long_description: Change Healthcare, acquired by UnitedHealth Group/Optum in 2022, is one of the largest healthcare technology companies providing revenue cycle management, claims clearinghouse services, and healthcare analytics. The platform processes billions of healthcare transactions annually and connects providers with most US payers. Change Healthcare is primarily used by large health systems, hospitals, and enterprise billing operations requiring maximum payer connectivity and scale. The company's products include claims submission, eligibility verification, payment processing, and clinical decision support tools.
one_liner: Enterprise healthcare clearinghouse and revenue cycle management from Optum.
best_for: Large health systems and hospital groups
Organizations already in the UnitedHealth/Optum ecosystem
